## Task-Specific Strategies (zebralogic)
1. [Strategy: CompactFinalAnswer] Place the solution JSON as the very last part of the response, with any reasoning before it, so the verifier parses only the intended answer.

3. [Strategy: OverlappingCategoryDisambiguation] When an attribute value appears in multiple categories (e.g., "cat" could be an animal or a pet), use contextual clues to decide which category it belongs to and keep the categories distinct.
   Apply when: During parsing of clues that contain ambiguous terms that could belong to more than one attribute set.

4. [Strategy: TransitiveEquivalenceLinking] When multiple clues each link a new attribute to an already linked attribute, propagate the equivalence across all linked attributes so that all of them belong to the same entity; treat the equivalence relation as transitive.

7. [Strategy: RelativeOrdering] Treat clues that say "X is somewhere to the left of Y" (or "right of") as a strict ordering constraint X < Y (or X > Y) without specifying distance, and enforce that X cannot be house 6 if it must be left of Y, etc.
